prompt:
Generate one square transparent game inventory atlas for GAIBANG wandering martial guild. Exactly 16 separate icons in an invisible 4x4 equal square grid, strict row-major order. Cell center coordinates x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Make icons deliberately SMALL, at most 55% of the cell width and height. For long staves use diagonal placement entirely inside the single cell with empty margins. Every item is centered and self-contained, with ample transparent gaps. Nothing overlaps another item or reaches the outer canvas edge. NO writing, lettering, numbers, labels, symbols that resemble text, visible grid, framing, scene background or glow. Paper surfaces may show only plain geometric diagrams, dotted routes or tiny abstract emblems; NO script. Hand-painted chibi wuxia object art, gouache and watercolor, fine warm brown contours, gentle upper-left lighting, 3/4 top view. Palette olive green and patchwork brown, ivory rough paper, aged bamboo and worn bronze. Respect all varied bindings and folded shapes, preserving readable physical differences between manuals. Make the clothing a complete unoccupied jacket, not worn by a character. Transparent alpha background.
Place this exact ordered list from left to right, top to bottom. Item numbers are NOT visible:
1. Thin patchwork-brown manual with olive cloth repairs, bamboo staff and roadside sign motifs.
2. Narrow olive cloth diagram with brown patched borders, white arcing paths and small staff silhouettes.
3. Thick stitched folio of brown and olive cloth-edged notes, exposed hemp thread and varied palm emblems.
4. Narrow brown-paper hand-copied book, olive cloth spine, intersecting alley lines and an open palm motif.
5. Small coarse brown-paper breathing booklet, olive repair stitching and two wooden page clasps.
6. Olive-covered book with patchwork-brown corners and mismatched travel bookmarks protruding from the pages.
7. Brown hardbound volume with long olive tie and a small bronze clasp shaped like steady hearth stones.
8. Half-open olive cloth scroll, brown alley lines and ivory footprints weaving around small blocks.
9. Brown oiled-paper folded leaves tied to a short bamboo strip, olive knot and inward-curving footprints.
10. Patchwork brown-and-olive notebook with colorful scrap-paper tabs, charcoal stub and visible coarse repairs.
11. Olive bamboo-jointed wooden staff, brown gripping wraps and dark bronze protective end bands.
12. Heavy dark-brown wooden staff with olive repair bindings, broad knots and a worn iron butt ring.
13. Olive and brown patchwork travel jacket, bold stitched patches and cord-fastened inner pouches.
14. Thick olive rope woven into a loop knot, brown wooden bead and short patched cloth tag hanging below.
15. Open brown coarse-cloth bundle holding several grain cakes, olive tying cord coiled beside it.
16. Folded old brown cloth map with multiple olive rope knots attached, one corner secured by a bamboo clip.
visual_review: 已再以 view_image 逐格核對 16 件。前四格清楚為竹棍動線、雙棍動線、龍與掌、蓮花與掌；第二排前三格為坐姿調息、經脈循環及臥姿調息，後續足跡、筆記、兩棍、衣袋糧圖與名稱一致。完成整體縮小後，各物件剪影完整、透明間距加寬，無文字或格線。
revision_prompt:
Edit the provided transparent 4-by-4 martial-arts inventory atlas. Keep exactly SIXTEEN separate inventory objects in the identical 4x4 row-major order. Preserve the painterly olive-green/brown/ivory patchwork visual style. All MANUALS MUST REMAIN physical RECTANGULAR BOOKS or rectangular rolled scrolls, recognizable as books rather than weapons, fans, badges or floating human figures. Draw the training symbols ON the book covers, not as extra floating objects. No readable writing, pseudo-letters, numbers, captions, grids or frames. Transparent alpha background. Every object silhouette must be complete, centered in its own equal square cell, with generous empty margins; make icons no wider than 78% of their cell. In particular, keep the bottom-left jacket safely inside its cell.
Change ONLY these first seven book/scroll icons to make their martial-art types unmistakable:
ROW 1 COL 1, staff-technique manual: retain rectangular patched brown book but replace roadside sign and small decorations with a clear simple GREEN BAMBOO STAFF illustration plus two curved staff-sweep paths. No sword, no fan, no road sign.
ROW 1 COL 2, snake-driving staff technique: retain rectangular olive cloth scroll; show two clearly visible brown STAFF illustrations at different angles linked by a winding S-shaped motion path, staff practice diagram. No snake creature required.
ROW 1 COL 3, Dragon-Subduing Palm: retain thick patchwork book; one large OPEN PALM imprint with a small curling CHINESE DRAGON illustration behind the palm, all flat printed cover art.
ROW 1 COL 4, Lotus Palm: retain rectangular narrow brown book; one prominent OPEN PALM above a small LOTUS FLOWER illustration. REMOVE street/map lines. Both palm and lotus must be clear.
ROW 2 COL 1, basic internal breathing: retain rectangular brown patched book with clasps; cover has simple seated meditating HUMAN TORSO silhouette with a clear circular breath-flow arrow encircling chest/abdomen, no weapon.
ROW 2 COL 2, Dragon-Mixed-Heaven internal cultivation: retain rectangular olive patched book with tabs; cover has a simple front-facing HUMAN TORSO meridian diagram, a central vertical dotted path and circular circulation loop, plus small dragon curl at corner. Dominant symbol must be body-and-breath diagram, NOT a palm attack or weapon.
ROW 2 COL 3, Sleeping Arhat internal cultivation: retain rectangular brown hardback with olive tie; cover clearly illustrates a small RECLINING HUMAN silhouette and a smooth circular breathing flow line around torso. Printed flat pictogram, not actual person outside book.
KEEP current ROW2COL4 footprints scroll, all four ROW3 items (footprints notes, training notebook, bamboo staff, dark wooden staff), and all four ROW4 items (patchwork jacket, disciple cloth pouch, food bundle, tied map), with same recognizable designs and positions. Only reduce any silhouette slightly if necessary to preserve broad transparent gutters. No object crosses a cell boundary. Final output is exactly one transparent 4x4 atlas.

Spacing correction:
Make a spacing-only correction to this supplied transparent 4x4 game inventory atlas. The SIXTEEN current object designs and their exact row-major order are correct: do not change any cover symbol, diagram, material, shape or color. Preserve all sixteen. Each complete icon is currently too large. Make EVERY ONE OF THE SIXTEEN icons only 78 percent of its CURRENT WIDTH AND HEIGHT, keeping its full original silhouette and all contents. CENTER each smaller icon in its own equal-sized square cell of the 4x4 atlas. The sixteen cell centers are x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of canvas. Leave a large transparent margin on all four sides of every icon. The bottom-left patchwork jacket MUST be smaller and centered, entirely within the first column, never extending to column two. All complete silhouettes fit within 80% of their cell width/height, including the two diagonal staffs. Keep the current top row: bamboo-staff book, two-staff scroll, palm-and-dragon book, palm-and-lotus book. Keep second row: seated breath book, standing meridian dragon book, reclining breathing book, footprint scroll. Keep third row footprint paper book, notes book, green bamboo staff, brown wooden staff. Keep bottom row patchwork jacket, disciple pouch, dry-food bundle, cloth map. Exactly 16 objects, no missing object, no additional object. Do not crop, duplicate, combine or remove parts. No text, grid, frame or visible background. Fully transparent alpha.
